subject: [PATCH v4 11/11] mm, swap: widen swap_info_struct max/pages to unsigned long

2026-08-25.patch_summary: This patch widens the size of swap_info_struct's max and pages fields from unsigned int to unsigned long, allowing the vswap device to exceed its previous 16 TB capacity limit when using 4 KB pages. The new maximum capacity is determined by the cluster_info_pool xarray's allocator limit, which can store up to ~8 PB at a typical SWAPFILE_CLUSTER=512 layout. This change enables larger swap devices and improves system performance for systems with high memory demands.
